title: Basin climate & land observatory
description: Complete Amu Darya and Syr Darya observations are the primary scope; the headwater formation layer remains available as a nested view. Earlier Uzbekistan-intersection products remain marked as legacy comparisons.

layers.label: Full-basin climate anomaly
layers.what: Monthly ERA5-Land departures from a fixed 1991-2020 normal across every level-7 unit in the complete Amu Darya and Syr Darya natural systems. Formation, transit and terminal reaches resolve through the same layer.

layers.label: Headwater climate anomaly
layers.what: Monthly ERA5-Land departures from a fixed 1991-2020 normal across every level-7 subbasin upstream of the Panj-Vakhsh and Naryn-Karadarya controls.

layers.label: Climate anomaly (legacy national)
layers.what: Observations expressed as z-scores against each basin's own climatological normal — how far this month sits from what that basin usually sees, not what the number is in absolute terms.

layers.label: Climate state (legacy national)
layers.what: Monthly mean of the 6-hourly CFSv2 field: precipitation, temperature, four soil-moisture depths, evaporative demand, radiation and humidity.

layers.label: Precipitation (CHIRPS)
layers.what: Accumulated rainfall per level-12 basin per pentad at 5.6 km — six measurements a month.

layers.label: Temperature & humidity (CHIRTS)
layers.what: Station-blended temperature and humidity at 5.6 km, 1983–2016, including day counts above 35° and 40°C a monthly mean cannot give.

layers.label: Temperature (CPC)
layers.what: Gauge-based half-degree temperature, 1979–present, with the station count that informed each cell.

layers.label: Air quality (CAMS)
layers.what: Monthly mean of the CAMS +0h analysis: aerosol optical depth and PM2.5, the assimilated estimate of what the atmosphere was, not a forecast.

layers.label: Full-basin state (ERA5-Land)
layers.what: Monthly temperature, precipitation, snowfall, snow water equivalent, soil moisture and modelled runoff for every level-7 unit in both complete river systems. ERA5-Land runoff is modelled and is not gauge discharge.

layers.label: Headwater formation (ERA5-Land)
layers.what: Monthly temperature, precipitation, snowfall, snow water equivalent, soil moisture and modelled runoff across the transboundary Upper Amu and Upper Syr formation zones. ERA5-Land is reanalysis; runoff here is not gauge discharge.

layers.label: Headwater snow cover (MODIS)
layers.what: Daily MODIS Terra snow cover for the Upper Amu and Upper Syr formation zones, aggregated from elevation bands using valid-observation area.

layers.label: Human modification
layers.what: Cumulative human modification for 2016 — settlement, agriculture, transport, mining and energy — as a 0 to 1 index at 1 km. One image, no timestamp: the single period is the whole record.
